title: [Prime] Mentos Pure Fresh Chewing Gum, Spearmint 10-Pack $16.62 ($14.96 S&S) (RRP $29.99) Delivered @ Amazon AU
body:
Deal: [Prime] Mentos Pure Fresh Chewing Gum, Spearmint 10-Pack $16.62 ($14.96 S&S) (RRP $29.99) Delivered @ Amazon AU

[lilviss] If extra is your preferred, this compared to extra bottles is $4.99/100g(10x30g bottles) for this vs $5.62/100g for Extra (6x 64g bottles)
[jgkeightley] I have been trying to find gum in reasonable quantities (i.e. not 1,000) for a few weeks. Please enjoy some dumb maths which helped me make some semblance of decision. Effective daily dose is 5-10g over 3-5 exposures in the day.
For the Mentos gum listed, each bottle lists 30g with 2g servings or 15 pieces of gum per bottle.11c per piece of gum which contains 0.6g of xylitol each. So 18c per 1g of xylitol.
This $119.00 1,000 pack includes 1.5g servings which include 1.06g of xylitol, so 11c per piece of gum and per 1g of xylitol.
But if you want Extra gum with xylitol, you can buy the Extra White Soft Chew which contain xylitol. $23.99 per six pack. Each pack contains 29 servings so at deal price it's 13c per piece of gum or 11c per 1g of xylitol.
[CodeXD] If this mentos gum contains 0.6g of xylitol each, and Effective daily dose is 5-10g over 3-5 exposures in the day.
Does that mean people should be chewing 9 of these gum per day?
Your Extra White Soft Chew link doesn't work - here it is for anyone who wants it
[jgkeightley] Thanks for the save on the link. Screw you Bezos.
That's right - 9 per day to hit the minimum clinical dose. I haven't read any of the clinical research articles to understand what a lower dose might elicit but anecdotally, I was chewing the Extra White Soft Chew then moved to LA gum (much less xylitol but I didn't check before buying) and I have noticed how much better my breath/mouth felt chewing that specific Extra than LA gum.
[jgkeightley] Dry mouth on new medication plus too long with inescapable coffee breath pushed me to a point where I needed a solution!
[Archaleas] Appreciated the write up, any tips on mints not gum?
[jgkeightley] For me, eclipse mints are my preference based on taste. I haven't looked for xylitol in mints because mints don't seem to address the dry mouth for me.
